## A useful question

Write ordinary Markdown here. For a CSV exported from an analysis project:

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| label: fig-estimates
#| fig-cap: "Estimated effects and their uncertainty intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Group estimates and uncertainty intervals."
results <- read.csv("posts/your-post/results.csv")
ggplot(results, aes(estimate, group)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lower, xend = upper, yend = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "Estimated effect", y = NULL)
```

Replace the example with your analysis results and remove `eval: false` when ready.
